YOU ARE THE MONSTER. Eight survivors. Three minutes. Kill them all.

MOVE  slap and push the ground, walls and trees with your hands. Let go to leap.

SWIPE  swing through a survivor. Faster swings tear limbs and heads off.

GRAB  hold grip (or trigger) on a limb and yank to rip it off. Grab the body to lift and throw them. Release to throw what you hold.

TURN  right thumbstick.  START  punch the red button in the lobby.

Desktop test: WASD + mouse, click = swipe (left/right claw), hold E / Q = grab, click while holding = yank, release = throw.
